Container.Name: ynab-mcp
Container.Overview: MCP (Model Context Protocol) server that connects Claude.ai to your YNAB budget. Allows Claude to read account balances, transactions, and category budgets in real time.

Config.Name: MCP Port
Config.Description: Port the MCP server listens on. Use this port when configuring Claude.ai remote MCP.

Config.Name: YNAB API Token
Config.Description: Your YNAB Personal Access Token. Generate one at https://app.ynab.com/settings/developer

Config.Name: YNAB Budget ID
Config.Description: Your YNAB budget ID (found in the URL when viewing your budget: app.ynab.com/budgets/YOUR-BUDGET-ID/). Leave as 'last-used' to auto-select your most recent budget.
